item.title: Medicaid cuts could add pressure to already-stressed psychiatric units
item.description: Psychiatric units are costly and, like labor and delivery services, typically lose money for hospitals and tend to be reimbursed at lower rates than other health services.

item.title: ICE to deploy at Pittsburgh International, but no visible presence Monday morning
item.description: There were no visible ICE agents in the terminal, but the Allegheny County Airport Authority expects the airport to be part of President Trump’s plan to deploy immigration agents to alleviate Transportation Security Administration (TSA) staffing shortages

item.title: Supreme Court skeptical of allowing states to count mail ballots that arrive after Election Day
item.description: The high court heard arguments on whether federal law overrides a Mississippi law that requires mail-in ballots that are postmarked on or before Election Day to be counted as long as they arrive within five business days of the election

item.title: Airport chaos: TSA agents skip work, security lines expand, Trump sends in ICE to assist
item.description: Nearly 3,500 Transportation Security Administration agents, roughly 11.8% of the scheduled nationwide workforce, called out from work Monday.

item.title: Lawmakers advance bill to give state additional oversight of new data center water use
item.description: It’s one of several efforts to create more oversight of the rapidly-growing sector powering the nation’s artificial intelligence boom .

item.title: Pittsburgh’s air pollution may claim 3,000+ lives per year − and EPA rollbacks aren’t helping
item.description: Air pollution is still responsible for an estimated 200,000 deaths across the U.S. each year. These deaths are not evenly distributed. Instead, they are concentrated in pollution hot spots.

item.title: Philadelphia mayor increases her proposed rideshare tax to help patch school district’s budget
item.description: Parker’s initial blueprint for next year’s budget, which she released March 12, included a tax of 20 cents per ride purchased through popular apps like Uber and Lyft that originate within city limits.
